edges.subject: CLN2
edges.quote: Mutations in the CLN2 gene lead to a neurodegenerative and blinding lysosomal storage disorder: late infantile neuronal ceroid lipofucinosis, also known as "CLN2 disease."

edges.subject: CLN2 disease
edges.quote: CLN2-associated retinopathy assessed using WCBS scores, fundus photographs, and OCT imaging, correlated with patient age.

edges.subject: CLN2 disease
edges.quote: Retinal degeneration associated with CLN2 disease manifests as a progressive, symmetrical decline, which appears to accelerate during a critical period at 48 to 72 months of age.

edges.subject: retina-specific CLN2 gene therapy
edges.quote: suggesting intervention with retina-specific CLN2 gene therapy should occur ideally before or as early as possible within this critical period.
